500011.name: Nitra

500071.name: Branč
500071.note: The live website www.branc.sk has no elections page or archive; its notice board and announcements reach back only sporadically and hold no okrsky document for this vote. The only okrsky document online is the mayor's decision No. OÚ-200-5/2026 of 9 July 2026 for the elections of 24 October 2026 (okrsok 1 = part Branč, okrsok 2 = part Veľká Ves), which is not valid for this vote. 500232.name: Golianovo
500232.note: No document of this vote with the okrsky found on golianovo.sk: the live site keeps only the NR SR 2023 document (súpisné čísla 2–359 / 360–803) among its okrsky documents; the 2026 referendum page has only an 'Oznámenie o čase a mieste konania referenda' without any address split; the notice board lists only 2026 items. The Internet Archive keeps almost nothing of golianovo.sk for 2017–2023 (16 URLs, no elections pages or PDFs).

500372.name: Jelenec
500372.note: The mayor's 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' of 09.11.2022 (on https://www.jelenec.sk/obecny-urad/volby-a-referenda/referendum-2023/) names only the polling room of each of the 2 okrsky, not their territory; the municipality has a single part and no streets, so the okrsky cannot be drawn.

500577.name: Mojmírovce
500577.note: The municipality's current website (new CMS, notice board from 2025) holds only 2026 election documents; the old website (WEBY GROUP CMS) is gone and only partly in the Internet Archive, which has no capture of the notice board or elections page from the weeks before this vote (the referendum of 21 January 2023), and no okrsky document for it (the 'Voľby a referendá' page captured 2018–2024 lists only old results). Only the 2017 (Voľby 2017 page) and 2026 (referendum) okrsky documents were found.

500704.name: Rišňovce
500704.note: The village's notice of 08.11.2022 for the referendum of 21 January 2023 (https://web.archive.org/web/20221109001953/https://risnovce.sk/pdf/referendum-2023/referendum-2023-volebny-okrsok.pdf) sets a single okrsok ("Volebný okrsok č. 1: súpisné čísla 3 – 816"), but the Statistical Office counts 2 okrsky for this vote; the notice cannot give rules for 2 okrsky.

500739.name: Močenok
500739.note: The website's notice board and news (searched page by page) have okrsky announcements for 2018, EP 2019, NR SR 2020, the local referendum of 24.06.2023, NR SR 2023, 2024 and 2026, but none for this vote (for 2017 only a notice of a changed polling room, without streets). The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

500810.name: Tesárske Mlyňany
500810.note: No okrsky notice for the referendum of 21 January 2023 was found: the referendum page of the former website lists only the voter information, the decision calling the referendum and the commission e-mail notice.

500941.name: Výčapy-Opatovce
500941.note: The only okrsky document found (Utvorenie volebných okrskov for the referendum of 4 July 2026, 05.05.2026) creates 2 okrsky with both polling rooms in the hall of the Kultúrny dom, Opatovská 204/1, without saying which addresses belong to which okrsok (the voters are split about equally, evidently by voter list); the other votes' pages (live and in the Internet Archive) list no okrsky document. No rules can be written.

501034.name: Bajč
501034.note: No okrsky document for the referendum of 21 January 2023 found: the archived referendum page lists only the president's decision, voter information and notices (hlasovací preukaz address). Later 2023/2024 documents give only polling stations for 3 okrsky while the municipality has 5 parts, so they could not be used anyway. Internet Archive was online.

501085.name: Čalovec
501085.note: The live notice board (searched in full for 'okrskov') keeps okrsky notices only for 2022, 2023 (NR SR), 2024 (president, EP) and October 2026; for this vote it has at most the notice on delegating okrsková komisia members, without okrsky. The Internet Archive's captures of calovec.sk begin in 2021 and its notice-board files (obsah…) of 2021–2026 include no okrsky notice for this vote.

501140.name: Hurbanovo
501140.note: The town's current website has election pages only for EP 2024, referendum 2026 and the 2026 elections; earlier pages (old site hurbanovo.sk/obcan/volby-…) survive only in the Internet Archive, which was unreachable (connection refused / 503). Live site also rate-limited (HTTP 429). Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

501182.name: Kameničná
501182.note: No referendum 2023 page or okrsky document on the site (WP media and page search).

501239.name: Marcelová
501239.note: Found the vote's 'Informácia o vytvorení volebných okrskov a určení volebných miestností' on the website. The document gives each okrsok only its polling station (okrsky 1 and 2 both in the Kultúrny dom, súp. č. 1161; okrsok 3 in the Materská škola, Námestie slobody 1395), with no streets or parts; the municipality has 3 okrsky but only 2 parts (Marcelová, Krátke Kesy), and two stations share one building, so the okrsky cannot be placed from it.

501395.name: Bátorove Kosihy
501395.note: The website keeps only 2026 election files; the only okrsky document found (for the municipal elections of October 2026) names 3 okrsky all in the cultural house no. 1263 with no addresses per okrsok, and the village is a single part with no streets, so no rules can be drawn even from it. The Internet Archive (online) holds no okrsky document of this vote (its 2018-2020 captures of the elections page files are candidate lists and voter information).

501425.name: Zlatná na Ostrove
501425.note: The website (elections section, full-text search) has no okrsky document of the referendum 2023 (its page has only voter information); the Internet Archive was offline. Later announcements (2018, 2023, 2024) use súp. č. 0-436 + Veľký Lél / 437-992 + Horná Zlatná.

501433.name: Dunajská Streda
501433.note: The referendum 2023 document (mayor's decision of 08.11.2022, utvorenie_volebnych_okrskov_a_urcenie_volebnych_miestnosti_10.pdf) creates 12 okrsky, while the Statistical Office's division for this vote has 13 (its voters list 12 okrsky 1–12); the ingest rejects 12 okrsky, so the document cannot be turned into valid rules for 13.

501522.name: Veľký Meder
501522.note: The referendum 2023 notice (posted 11. 11. 2022) gives only the 8 okrsky's polling stations, not their streets; the town has only 2 parts, so the okrsky cannot be drawn from it.

501573.name: Gabčíkovo
501573.note: Gabčíkovo (one part, one k.ú.) never published street lists for its okrsky. The website's elections pages (live: categories 2020, 2023, 2024 x2, 2026 x2; archived old Joomla site 2017-2022 in sk and hu) hold no okrsky document for this vote (referendum 2023: the archived article "Referendum 2023" shows only a poster with the date and the polling place "ZŠ László Amadea s VJM, v budove B"). Every okrsky document the city did publish (NR SR 2023, president 2024, EP 2024, referendum 2026, municipal 2026) names for okrsky 1-4 only the polling station, all four in the same building (ZŠ L. Amadého s VJM, Komenského 1081/1, B budova), with no streets; with 4 okrsky, one part and all stations in one building, no rules can be derived. Internet Archive was intermittently unreachable (connection refused) and needed repeated retries; some 2017 pages (hu item 268) never loaded.

501581.name: Holice
501581.note: The obec's website (www.obecholice.sk -> www.gelle.sk; the old www.holice.sk is a parked domain) keeps on its notice board (current and archive by year 2017-2026) okrsky documents only for the NR SR election of 2023-09-30 and the EP election of 2024-06-08; for this vote it has none (for 2017 only an 'Informácie pre voliča' DOCX, for 2026 referendum items without an okrsky decision). The Internet Archive CDX API timed out and then refused connections for about 15 minutes; the availability API shows only a 2019 homepage capture of gelle.sk, which could not be opened.

501590.name: Horná Potôň
501590.note: Referendum 2023: only voter information (item 246) published; no okrsky document. The current site's elections section (live and archived records, categories NR SR 2020, NR SR 2023, referendum 2023, prezident 2024, EP 2024, referendum 2026) holds only voter information, e-mail addresses and minutes for these votes; the only okrsky document is "N-9-volebné okrsky.doc" of 2022 (3 okrsky, places only), which is another vote's.

501603.name: Horný Bar
501603.note: No okrsky determination for the referendum of 21 January 2023 on the obec's website: the notice board archive (all records from 2015) lists no "utvorenie volebných okrskov" for this vote; its referendum notices are voter information and the delegation address (ids 210, 211). The site search for "okrsk" finds only the 2026 notices. The Internet Archive (CDX API) was unreachable at the time, so archived copies could not be checked.

501611.name: Dolný Štál
501611.note: The referendum 2023 post (2022-11-09) links only ministry documents; no okrsky document of the municipality for the referendum found (WP posts/media search).

501638.name: Hviezdoslavov
501638.note: No page or document for the referendum of 2023 on the elections section (pages: 2022, NR SR 2023, 2024 votes, 2026). Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

501662.name: Janíky
501662.note: Okrsky documents on janiky.sk exist only for the National Council election of 2023 (evt_file 3473 + notice 576sk); the sections for this vote (live and archived) hold no okrsky document, and a 2023 document is not valid for this vote.

501719.name: Kútniky
501719.note: The website (a Joomla site listing its notices as PDFs on the home page) never posted an okrsky document except for the 2022 elections (and 2026): the archived home pages of 2021-2026 list for the referendum 2023, NRSR 2023, presidential and EP 2024 and the referendum 2026 only voter information, e-mail notices and commission minutes; the Internet Archive has nothing of 2017-2020 elections and the live site keeps only 2025-2026 notices.

501727.name: Kvetoslavov
501727.note: The referendum 2023 document (9.11.2022) only creates 2 okrsky both voting at the Obecný úrad, without saying which addresses belong to which; no rules can be written from it. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout, so archived pages could not be checked.

501735.name: Lehnice
501735.note: The municipality (2 okrsky, 5 parts, no streets) publishes no utvorenie volebných okrskov with their territory on its website, live or archived; the archived referendum 2023 page holds no okrsky document.

501743.name: Lúč na Ostrove
501743.note: The obec's Voľby page (live, and as the Internet Archive kept it in 2019 and 2022) has a category "Referendum 2023" but no decision on the okrsky and polling stations for this vote: only the announcement of the vote, the e-mail address for delegating commission members, the Ministry's information for voters (generic, no okrsky) and, for elections, candidate lists or commission minutes. The live notice board is empty and none of its archived documents (old e_download.php and data/uredni_deska files, file_storage downloads in the CDX) concerns the okrsky. The only okrsky decision the website has is the one for the municipal and regional elections of 24 October 2026 (download.php?file=4486d01c|545), which is not this vote's. The Internet Archive answered. A web search for the okrsky of Lúč na Ostrove found nothing else.

501808.name: Nový Život
501808.note: The website's pages of the votes (news items 'Voľby …', 'Referendum 2026') link no okrsky document of the 2023 referendum vote (only results, minutes, voter information); the notice board keeps only current items; the only okrsky document on the site is that of the elections of 24 October 2026. The Internet Archive's web.archive.org refused every connection for over 30 minutes (only the availability API answered), so no archived pages or documents could be read.
tried: https://www.novyzivot.sk/evt_file.php?file=2288 … 2330 (unlinked files of spring 2026, by file name)

501824.name: Okoč
501824.note: The referendum 2023 page (archived; gone live) has only the postal-vote information and a contact/e-mail DOCX; no okrsky document.
tried: https://www.okoc.sk/e_download.php?file=data/uredni_deska/obsah1_1.pdf … obsah400_1.pdf (every file of the notice board, 244 found, none on okrsky)

501859.name: Orechová Potôň
501859.note: No okrsky document found for this vote. The Internet Archive's CDX of orechovapoton.sk (2016–2026) lists the old site's election pages (information for voters, e-mail addresses, the 2018 page stating 'Počet okrskov: 2') and result records, but no 'utvorenie volebných okrskov' or list of streets per okrsok. The Internet Archive was offline at times but answered after retries.

501921.name: Topoľníky
501921.note: No okrsky document of this vote found. The current website (topolniky.sk, new CMS) shows on its notice board only the okrsky of the elections of 24 October 2026; the old WordPress site's pages for this vote, as far as the Internet Archive kept them (2019-2020 NRSR voter information, the 2023 referendum page, 2022 candidate lists), carry no okrsky notice; the only okrsky announcement found is that of the National Council election of 2023.

502006.name: Vrakúň
502006.note: The live site keeps only the October 2026 okrsky notice (okrsok 1 časť obce Vrakúň, okrsok 2 časť obce Nekyje na Ostrove). The Internet Archive's captures of vrakun.sk (CDX 2017–2026) hold no okrsky document of 2017, 2018, 2019 or 2020 and none for 2024 (the 2024 elections pages and the one PDF retrievable hold only e-mail notices; other captures failed to load). For the referendum of 21 January 2023 the archive has 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov pre referendum' (Vo Vrakúni 10.11.2022): it says only that 2 okrsky were formed, both voting in the obecný úrad, Nám. sv. Štefana 474/1; it names no parts or streets, and with both stations in one building the okrsky cannot be told apart, so no rules can be written.

502014.name: Vydrany
502014.note: No okrsky document of the referendum 2023 found: the referendum page (live and as archived on 2022-12-06 and 2023-03-22) links only the voter information, and the village's radio announcement says only that there are 2 okrsky with their polling stations (Kultúrny dom, Základná škola). The notice board shows only current items; the Internet Archive kept none of its late-2022 items. With a single part in the register, the okrsky cannot be drawn from polling stations alone.

502022.name: Zlaté Klasy
502022.note: The municipality has an elections page for each vote (live and in the Internet Archive), but none of them links an okrsky document (they hold the information for voters, delegation forms and the okrsky commissions' minutes). The only okrsky document found, "rozdelenie ulíc do okrskov" (evt_file.php?file=7010), is on the page of the 2022 municipal and regional elections, a vote not among these.

502031.name: Levice
502031.note: The live website's election pages list only results (minutes per okrsok) for this vote, no mayor's okrsky document; the úradná tabuľa (CG eGOV) shows only current postings. The Internet Archive's CDX for levice.sk answered 504/timeouts for most years over ~20 minutes of retries (only 2018 and 2020 lists came back, without okrsky documents); its captures of the old elections pages hold no okrsky notice. The council's obvody resolution of 02.08.2018 lists 47 okrsky but is no document of this vote.

502421.name: Kozárovce
502421.note: No okrsky document for the 2023 referendum found (novinka/38529 archived without such file). Kozárovce has one part and no streets (1005 addresses by súpisné číslo); its okrsky documents (2022, 2023 NRSR, 2024 EP) only state that there are 2 okrsky, both voting in ZŠ s MŠ Kozárovce č. 927, without any addresses or house numbers per okrsok, so no split of the village can be written or inferred.

502642.name: Plášťovce
502642.note: The live website has no elections section; its notice board and archive reach back only to spring 2026 and hold no okrsky document. The Internet Archive (web.archive.org CDX API) stayed offline (HTTP 503 / connection failures) for over 20 minutes of retries with pauses, so archived pages of earlier votes could not be searched.

502715.name: Santovka
502715.note: The elections page archived on 2023-06-26 links a 'Referendum 2023' page, but that page already redirected to the site's 404 page when archived on 2023-06-26 and is 404 live; no capture of it with content exists, and no referendum document is among the archived PDFs. The notice board capture of 2023-06-26 could not be fetched (Internet Archive answered HTTP 429).

502821.name: Tekovské Lužany
502821.note: Every okrsky notice on the website (president 2019 of 30.01.2019, referendum 2023, NR SR 2023 of 22.06.2023, president 2024, EP 2024, referendum 2026 of 24.04.2026) only gives the number of okrsky (3) and their polling stations (Obecný úrad SNP 43, Základná škola J. A. Komenského 37, bývalá MŠ Družstevná 87), not which streets vote where; the municipality has a single part, so no okrsok can be inferred from its station. No 2017 or 2018 okrsky document is on the site. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

503185.name: Gbelce
503185.note: The website has no elections section; the notice board and news list only items from 2024 on (the EP 2024 item is the only one with an okrsky document; the referendum 2026 item has results only). Host rate-limits (HTTP 429). Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

503321.name: Lipová
503321.note: The current website keeps election documents only for the October 2026 elections (and results of the 2026 referendum); no okrsky document of this vote and no older election pages. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

503380.name: Veľký Kýr
503380.note: The municipality's document register (searched for "okrsk" and "miestnost") has okrsky documents only of 2024 and 2026, none of the referendum 2023; Internet Archive offline.

503550.name: Strekov
503550.note: The live and archived (Internet Archive) pages of the vote on strekov.sk list no okrsky document, only information, the law, e-mail notices and the commissions' minutes; the notice board has none either. Referendum 2023 page: the President's decision 2022_362.pdf and an e-mail notice only. Internet Archive was intermittently offline but answered after retries.

503568.name: Svodín
503568.note: No okrsky document found for this vote. The live elections page has only the 2026 municipal documents (with the 2026 okrsky list); the 2026 referendum notice has only the commission records; the site search for 'okrsk' finds nothing older. The Internet Archive's captures of the old (WordPress) and new site's election pages and notices (2017, 2018, 2019, referendum 2023, NR SR 2023) list voters' information, postal vote, e-mail and council-size notices, but no okrsky document, and its CDX of svodin.sk has no okrsky file.

503584.name: Štúrovo
503584.note: The city publishes an "Informácia pre voličov o určení volebných okrskov a miestností" per vote; the live elections pages keep it for the NR SR election 2023, the presidential election 2024 and the referendum 2026 only. The pages of this vote (live or as archived in the Internet Archive) link no such document (the 2019 page only the decision calling the election and the voter information; the EP 2024 page only results).

503614.name: Tvrdošovce
503614.note: No okrsky document with streets found. The municipality's election pages (old site, live at archiv.tvrdosovce.sk/informacie/volby, 2013-2024; new site tvrdosovce.sk/volby.html from 2026) give for 2017 and 2023 only the polling stations of the 4 okrsky (ZŠ Nová cesta; Obecný/Kultúrny dom for 2 and 3; MŠ Hlboká), with no streets, and for the other votes no okrsky notice at all; the Internet Archive's index adds nothing. With one part and 4 okrsky the split cannot be inferred.

503631.name: Veľké Lovce
503631.note: No document delimiting the two okrsky for this vote: the archived election pages of 2017–2020 link only voter information, the announcement of the vote and results; the referendum 2023 decision (11.11.2022) only names the two polling rooms. Documents with the súpisné ranges exist for 2022, NR SR 2023 and both 2024 votes.

503649.name: Zemné
503649.note: The archived referendum 2023 article links an okrsky notice (.doc), but it is gone live (404) and not in the Internet Archive.

503711.name: Diakovce
503711.note: The website's elections section has pages only for NR SR 2020 (voter information, e-mail address, call — no okrsky), 2022 and 2026; no okrsky document for this vote. The Internet Archive was flaky/refusing connections during the search.

503771.name: Horné Saliby
503771.note: Horné Saliby publishes a decision on okrsky per vote on its elections pages (hornesaliby.sk/samosprava/volby/), but the pages kept are those of 2022 (archive), the presidential and EP elections of 2024 and the referendum 2026; the pages of this vote (where they exist, e.g. NR SR 2023, referendum 2023) link no okrsky document. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline) during the search.

503835.name: Jelka
503835.note: The referendum page's item 'Referendum – volebné okrsky' links only the President's decision calling the referendum; the scan doc02473320221209110434.pdf is the voting-certificate notice. No okrsky document found. Jelka publishes for its votes only the number of okrsky and their polling stations (e.g. https://jelka.sk/wp-content/uploads/dokumenty/volby-do-narodnej-rady-sr/doc02890320230807110021-9h1175.pdf for 2023 and https://jelka.sk/wp-content/uploads/dokumenty/volby-prezidenta/doc03233820240130132240-197baj.pdf for 2024: okrsky 1 and 2 in the same building on Školská, okrsok 3 at Hlavná 760), never which streets vote where; with 3 okrsky in one part of the municipality they cannot be turned into rules.

503959.name: Pata
503959.note: No okrsky notice for this vote: the live election pages (2024 presidential and EP) and every archived elections page of obecpata.sk (2018–2024, captured before the votes) carry only the announcement and voter information, no 'oznámenie o vytvorení volebných okrskov'; the site publishes the okrsky (by súpisné číslo) only on the 2022 and 2026 pages. Another vote's notice is not this vote's.

504009.name: Sereď
504009.note: The archived referendum 2023 page links "volebné okrsky a volebné miestnosti" (subory/230/20221110164153_...pdf), but the file is gone from the website (404) and the Internet Archive has no capture of it.

504017.name: Sládkovičovo
504017.note: The city's elections page keeps okrsky notices only from 2023 on; the notice-board archive holds only the 2016 NR SR list. No document of this vote found. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

504025.name: Šaľa
504025.note: The town's article for this vote (Internet Archive) links the okrsky document ('02a Informácia o utvorení volebných okrskov a určení volebných miestností - SJ', component_file 9470/f4835), but the Internet Archive has no copy of the PDF (requests return its 'not found' page) and the live file cannot be fetched. The town's website answers 'Access Forbidden' to our requests, so only Internet Archive copies could be used.

504068.name: Tešedíkovo
504068.note: Found the referendum 2023 'Informácia o utvorení volebných okrskov a určení volebných miestností' (obsah509_5.pdf), but it names only the three polling stations. Every okrsky document Tešedíkovo published (referendum 2023, NR SR 2023, president 2024, EP 2024, referendum 2026, municipal/regional 2026) gives each of its 3 okrsky only its polling station (Dom kultúry č. 860; MŠ č. 153; Školská jedáleň ZŠ č. 974), never which houses vote where. The municipality has one part and no streets in the register, so the okrsky cannot be placed or inferred from the stations (the prompt's part-inference needs as many parts as okrsky).

504106.name: Trstice
504106.note: No okrsky document for the referendum of 21 January 2023 on trstice.sk. Its notice-board items are the President's decision (item 229), the addresses for voting-certificate and postal-vote applications (item 230) and the generic voter information in Slovak and Hungarian (items 231, 339); none names the okrsky. The okrsky document of 29.10.2022 is another vote's. Every item of the official notice board (úradná tabuľa, items 1–444, 2016–2026, incl. the items migrated from the old Joomla site) was listed by id and every election item opened; the Internet Archive (CDX of trstice.sk, old site trstice.sk/sk/aktuality/…) was searched for election pages and radio announcements (hlásenie miestneho rozhlasu) around the vote; the IA was slow and often refused connections, but the pages listed in tried were retrieved.

504114.name: Váhovce
504114.note: The notice board of obecvahovce.sk has for the referendum of 2023 only the information for voters (SK/HU) and two e-mail address notices (16. 11. 2022, 8. 12. 2022); no okrsky decision for the referendum. The okrsky document of 4. 8. 2022 (for the elections of 29. 10. 2022) is the latest before it, but no 2023 document repeats it.

504122.name: Veľká Mača
504122.note: Veľká Mača's okrsky documents (2023 NRSR, 2024 president, 2024 EP, 2026 municipal/regional) only create 2 okrsky and name their polling stations, both in the same building (Obecný úrad, Sereďská 137: zasadačka / sobášna sieň); none assigns streets or house numbers. The municipality has one part and no street names, so the okrsky cannot be inferred from stations. No 2017–2022 documents are on the site and the Internet Archive has no captures of velkamaca.sk for 2017–2022.

504131.name: Veľké Úľany
504131.note: The municipality's okrsky notices (2024 presidential, 2026) give only the four polling stations, all in the same part (Veľké Úľany, Hlavná 579/8 and 578/9), with no streets or parts per okrsok; no document with streets is on the website, and the Internet Archive keeps only the old frames site (no election documents for 2017–2023).

504203.name: Senica
504203.note: The city's election articles are reused for each new vote (the municipal and regional pages now show 2026 only), so this vote's documents are no longer linked; older files survive only under unknown article/file ids. The Internet Archive's CDX was offline ('Temporarily Offline', HTTP 503) for over 15 minutes, so archived copies could not be searched.

504254.name: Brestovec

509493.name: Svrčinovec
509493.note: No okrsky document of the referendum of 21 January 2023 on svrcinovec.sk: the site search (okrsk, okrskov, volby, voľby, referendum, urcenie) finds only the elections pages of 2017, 2018 and the 2019 presidential election. The referendum pages (calendar, archived news page) give only voting information and the mail-vote form. The Internet Archive (CDX of svrcinovec.sk 2017–2026, after several retries while it was temporarily offline) holds no okrsky document of this vote: its captures of the notice board attachments do not cover the election announcements, and no elections page of this vote is archived. The decisions of 2017 and 2019 that exist define the okrsky only by kopanice names absent from the register, so they could not be transcribed either. Svrčinovec has no streets and one part (Svrčinovec); every address is a súpisné číslo. The okrsky documents of 2017 and of the presidential election of 2019 (identical lists) define the 3 okrsky only by kopanice/osady names: okrsok 1 U Jurištov, U Skorky, U Mišov, U Katraka, U Krišice, U Hlaváča, U Berka, U Švoľka, U Cyprichov, Pod Grapami, U Puraša, U Privarčáka; okrsok 2 U Kupky, Pod bučky a valy, U Vajdíka, U Meščky, U Kubale, U Okapola, U Janka, U Matiaška, U Blažkov; okrsok 3 U Liščáka, Škradné, Potok a Bordža (polling stations: kultúrny dom, ZŠ, kaplnka na Závrší). None of these names is a street, part or k.ú. of the register, and no source gives their house numbers. Seven of them (U Skorky, U Krišice, U Švoľka, U Meščky, U Kubale, U Okapola, U Janka) are not in ZBGIS geographic names (inspirews.skgeodesy.sk GN) or OSM at all, and the located ones of okrsky 1 and 2 are interleaved all over the village (e.g. Pod Grapami (1) west of Matiaškovci (2), Vajdíkovci (2) beside Jurištovci (1)). Assigning each register address to the nearest located osada gives 691/199/162 addresses for okrsky 1/2/3, against 1199/1294/311 voters on the roll in 2018 (okrsok 2 should be the largest), so the split between okrsky 1 and 2 (in particular of the village centre) cannot be drawn without guessing. Only okrsok 3 (Závršie, Škradné, Potok, separated from the centre) would be clear.

514926.name: Hrušovo

515001.name: Jesenské

515442.name: Rimavská Seč

515736.name: Veľké Teriakovce

Each of those announcements names only the two polling stations (okrsok 1: zasadačka Obecného úradu Veľké Teriakovce; okrsok 2: Kultúrny dom Vrbovce nad Rimavou) and no parts or houses; the municipality has 4 parts (Krásna, Malé Teriakovce, Veľké Teriakovce, Vrbovce nad Rimavou) but 2 okrsky, so the station-per-part inference does not apply and the okrsky cannot be written from it.

515850.name: Veľký Krtíš
515850.note: The mayor's decision of 25.11.2022 for this referendum (https://web.archive.org/web/20221221002021/https://www.velky-krtis.sk/download_file_f.php?id=1763244, linked from the archived referendum-2023 page) defines 10 okrsky (voters without an address in okrsok 10), but the Statistical Office's division for this vote has 11 (okrsok 11 with 3 voters), which the document does not name; ingest rejected the 10 okrsky ('10 okrsky given, the territorial division has 11'). Its 10 okrsky are those already curated as the referendum supplement of the 2022 obvody, so the rules exist if the maintainer accepts the extra okrsok 11 as addressless.

516295.name: Pôtor
516295.note: The notice board has no okrsky document of this vote (for the 2026 referendum only the appointment of OVK recorders, which names the okrsky but not their territory); older items are removed. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

516520.name: Vinica
516520.note: The website vinica.sk (live) has elections pages from 2024 on and the notice board archive to 2019, none with an okrsky document (only results, candidate lists, voter information). The Internet Archive (CDX of vinica.sk, 2017-2026) holds no okrsky document: its 2017-2018 captures are of the old site (May/August 2017) without elections material; the only okrsky item found is the 2023 NRSR page 'Zoznam ulíc a okrskov pre voľby do NR SR' whose DOCX (210sk_1.docx) is gone live (404) and was never archived; the referendum 2023 and 2022 pages' PDFs are gone live and not archived. 516546.name: Záhorce

516759.name: Hodruša-Hámre

516830.name: Hronský Beňadik

516970.name: Kremnica

517186.name: Prestavlky

517381.name: Žarnovica

517429.name: Belá

517461.name: Bytča

517488.name: Divina

517500.name: Dlhé Pole

517526.name: Dolný Hričov

517674.name: Kolárovice

517861.name: Petrovice

517895.name: Predmier

The Internet Archive's index of predmier.sk (old CMS, 2016-2020) lists no elections page or okrsky document. 518051.name: Turie

518085.name: Veľké Rovné

The elections page has no okrsky announcement for 2017, 2019, 2020 or the 2023 referendum; those of 2023-2024 are scans of the same kind.

518093.name: Višňové

518263.name: Detva
518263.note: The town's 'Oznam o utvorení volebných okrskov…' for the referendum of 21 January 2023 (download_file_f.php?id=1764145, dated 10.11.2022) forms 15 okrsky, but the Statistical Office counts 16 (okrsok 16 with 3 voters, not in the document); the document cannot be numbered 1..16, so reported not_found.

518271.name: Detvianska Huta

518425.name: Hontianske Tesáre

518549.name: Kriváň

518557.name: Krupina

518590.name: Ľubotice

With 3 okrsky in 2 parts and two okrsky in one building, the okrsky cannot be placed by part. No street list for this vote was found on the page.

518808.name: Sliač

518913.name: Sverepec
518913.note: Sverepec's website (no elections page) shows on its notice board only election zápisnice and candidate lists; no okrsky document for any vote 2017-2026 found live. The Internet Archive (CDX) stayed offline on repeated attempts over ~20 minutes.

519197.name: Giraltovce
519197.note: The town's decisions on the okrsky (e.g. 3 September 2018, 9 November 2022 for the 2023 referendum, 4 May 2026 for the 2026 referendum) list the 3 okrsky only by number and polling station (all on Dukelská), with no streets or houses; the town has 2 parts (Giraltovce, Francovce), so the 3 okrsky cannot be drawn from them, and no street list of the okrsky was found.

520098.name: Čabalovce
520098.note: No official website of the village was found (cabalovce.sk and obeccabalovce.sk do not resolve; web search finds only aggregators). The village has no street names and one part, so its 2 okrsky could only be told apart by an official list of súpisné čísla, which was not found. Internet Archive offline.

520331.name: Kamenica nad Cirochou
520331.note: The municipality published its okrsky (streets per okrsok) only in voter notices for NR SR 2023, the presidential election 2024 and EP 2024. Its pages for this vote (live or archived) carry only the general voter information and minutes, no okrsky document.

520471.name: Medzilaborce

520802.name: Snina

520829.name: Stakčín

No page or document for the other votes.

521299.name: Čaňa

521493.name: Jasov

521523.name: Kecerovce

521639.name: Kysak
521639.note: Kysak's okrsky documents (určenie volebných okrskov of 29.7.2022, 19.6.2023, 23.1.2024; the other votes' pages in the Internet Archive list none) only create okrsok 1 and 2 with their rooms and say 'Voliči budú zaradení do volebných okrskov podľa súpisného čísla' without giving which súpisné numbers go where, so no rules can be written. The website itself refuses connections from here.

521655.name: Malá Ida

521671.name: Medzev

521931.name: Rozhanovce

521973.name: Seňa

522279.name: Michalovce

522376.name: Budkovce

522872.name: Pavlovce nad Uhom

523089.name: Sobrance
523089.note: The referendum's document (Informácia o volebných okrskoch a volebných miestnostiach, primátor 10.11.2022, https://www.sobrance.sk/download_file_f.php?id=1764463) forms 5 okrsky (the same as 2022), but the Statistical Office counts 6 okrsky for this vote (the 6th with 2 voters); the document defines no 6th okrsok, so its rules cannot match this vote's okrsky.

523488.name: Hôrka

523585.name: Kežmarok

523623.name: Lendak
523623.note: No okrsky document for this vote on lendak.sk, live or in the Internet Archive: the vote's pages (live notice-board posts for 2023 referendum and 2024 votes; archived pages of the 2018 municipal and 2019 presidential elections) carry only e-mail addresses, the announcement and voter information. 523631.name: Liptovská Teplička

Š. Garaja 398/16), not which streets belong to each okrsok; the municipality has one part, so the okrsky cannot be inferred from the stations.

523798.name: Rakúsy

523925.name: Svit

524000.name: Veľká Lomnica

524140.name: Prešov

524603.name: Jarovnice

525146.name: Sabinov

525413.name: Víťaz

525529.name: Rožňava
525529.note: The city's document for the referendum of 21 January 2023 (č. MsÚ/RV-5160/2022-52115-SPRÁVA of 07.11.2022, files/2022-11-10-094232-referendum_-_ur__enie_okrskov.pdf) sets 18 okrsky with streets (same as 2023 NR SR), but the Statistical Office counts 19 okrsky for this vote (okrsok 19 with 5 voters, presumably a special okrsok not in the document); the document gives no 19th okrsok, so valid rules for 19 okrsky cannot be written.

525634.name: Dobšiná
525634.note: No retrievable okrsky document of this vote.
